उडू-प m. the moon, L.

tri॰ utkfzwo qAmaraH prA॰ sa॰ । 1 udBawe 2 SrezWe ca 3 tantraBede pu॰ ।
m: उड्-डामर mfn. (fr. उद्-डा˚?), excellent, respectable, of high rank or consequence, Prab.; Bālar. &c.
a: उड्डामर — a. 1 Agreeable, excellent, respectable. --2 Formidable, terrific; उड्डामरव्यस्तविस्तारिदोःखंडपर्यासितक्ष्माधरम Māl. 5. 23.

m: उड्-डामर—तन्त्र n. N. of a Tantra.
उड्डामरिन् mfn. one who makes an extraordinary noise, Bālar.
उड्-√ डी (उद्-√ डी) Ā. -डयते, or डीयते, to fly up, soar, Hit.; Pañcat.; MBh. &c. : Caus. -डापयति, to cause to fly up, scare.
a: उड्डी — {c1c} {c4c} A. To fly up, soar. --Caus. To scare away.

s: puM, (ut + qI + Sa । yadvA uqqAnAM utpaTagAminAM yoginAmityarTaH ISaH mahAdevasya yogISvaratvAt .) AgamaSAstraviSezaH । SivaH । iti medinI ॥
v: uqqISa

pu॰ ud + qI--kvip tasya ISaH । utpatana kartfRAmISvare 1 mahAdeve 2 tantraBede ca medi॰ । yoginAM hi utpatanaM yogaSAstraprasidDam mahAdevasya ca tadISatvAt taTAtvam । uqqISatrantrasya tu utpatanasADanopAyaviDAyakatvAt taTAtvam ।
m: उड्डीश m. N. of Śiva, L.
N. of a Tantra work (containing charms and incantations), L.
a: उड्डीशः — 1 N. of a work containing charms and incantation. --2 N. of Śiva.

s: klI, (ut + qI + kla .) KagagatikriyA । pakziRAM UrdDvagamanam । ityamaraH ॥ (“ahaM sampAtAdikAnazwAnuqqInagativiSezAn vedmi” । iti paYcatantre ॥)
v: uqqIna

उड्-डीन n. flying up, soaring, Pañcat.
a: उड्डीन — p. p. Flown up, flying up. --नं 1 Flying up, soaring. --2 A particular flight of birds.

k.v: प्रडीनोड्डीनसंडीनान्येताः खगगतिक्रियाः। पेशी कोशो द्विहीनेऽण्डं कुलायो नीडमस्त्रियाम्.।

m: उड्डीय-कवि m. N. of a poet.

s: tri, (ut + qI + SAnac .) uqqayanaviSizwapakzyAdiH । uqanta oqtA ityAdi BAzA ॥
m: उड्-डीयमान mfn. flying up, soaring, one who soars, Hit.

v: uqqIyana

na॰ ud + qI--qa uqqaHsa ivAcarati kyaN uqqIya--BAve lyuw । utpatane । “kaTamuqqIyane'SaktAn patane ca mamAtmajAn” mA॰ A॰ 233 a॰ । uqqIya--karttari tAcCIlye vA cAnaS । uqqIyamAna uqqayana karttari tacCIle ca tri॰ ।
m: उड्-डीयन n. flying up, soaring, MBh.
उड्-डमर = उड्-डामर below.
उड्डमरित mfn. stirred up, excited.

s: klI, (ut + qI + lyuw .) naBogatiH । oqA iti BAzA । yaTA nEzaDe 1 । 125 ॥ “gato virutyoqqayane nirASatAm” ॥ (“so'pi tamAdAya sampAtoqqayanena prasTitaH” । iti paYcatantre ॥)
v: uqqayana
na॰ ud + qI--lyuw । pakziRAmUrdDagatO “gato virutyeqqayane nirASatAm” nEza॰ ।
m: उड्-डयन See उड्-डी.
उड्-डयन n. flying up, flying, soaring, Pañcat.
a: उड्डयनं — Flying up, soaring; गतो विरुत्योड्डयने निराशतां N. 1. 125.

m: उड्डियाण m. N. of a place.
उड्डियान n. a particular position of the fingers.

v: u(o)qra

pu॰ uqa--sO॰ bA॰ rak ra vA u--ra--rak vA qugAgamovA । kUrmaviBAgasTaprAcyadeSaBede “savaNgANgAn sapORqroqrAn sacolAn draviqrAnDakAn” BA॰ za॰ 56 a॰ । o(u)qradeSaSca kUrmmaviBAge vf॰ saM॰ prAcyatayoktaH yaTA “prAcyAmityupakramya miTilasamatawoqrASvavadanadanturakAH” iti । sa ca utkalAt Binnaeva tatrEvAnantaram “pORqrotkalakASimekalAmbazWAH ityukteH । BArate ca sahadevadakziRadigvijaye “pARqyAMSca draviqAMScEva sahitAMScoqrakeralEH sa॰ 30 a॰ uktestasya hastinAnagarItaH dakziRatvAt taTAtvam kUrmmaviBAge prAcyatvamiti na viroDaH । sarvatra uqraSabdaSravaRAt ukArAditvam raGunandanena tu oqrAdideSavyavasTitamityuktatvAt okArAditvamapi । asya deSavAcitvAt tasya rAjA tadasyABijana ityarTe ca aR । Oqra tadrAje tadvAsini ca bahuzu tasya luk । uqraH tadrAjezu tannivAsizu ca ।
m: उड्र m. pl. N. of a people, MBh.; VarBṛS. &c.
a: उड्रः — N. of a country; the modern Orissa; see ओड्र.

s: klI strI, (u rozoktipUrvvakaM qayate iti । u + qI + qu mitadbrAditvAt quH .) nakzatram । ityamaraH ॥ (“tadoqurAjaH kukuBaH karErmuKam” । iti BAgavataM । 10 । 29 । 2 । taTA raGuvaMSe । 16 । 65 । “induprakASAntaritoqutulyAH” .) jale klI । ityamarawIkAyAM BarataH ॥
v: uqu
strI na॰ uqa--bA॰ ku । 1 nakzatre, 2 jale ca strItve vA UN । “induprakASastimitoqutulyAH” । “uttamBitoquBiratIvatarAM SiroBiH” mAGaH ।
m: उडु f. n. a star, Ragh.; BhP.; Mālav. &c.
उडु n. a lunar mansion or constellation in the moon's path, VarBṛS. &c.
water, L.
a: उडुः — f. उडु n. [उड्-वा˚ क] 1 A lunar mansion; a star; इंदुप्रकाशांतरितोडुतुल्याः R. 16. 65. --2 Water (said to been. only). --Comp. --चक्रं zodiacal circle. --पः --पं [उडुनि जले पाति] a raft, boat; तितीर्षुर्दुस्तरं मोहाढुडुपेनास्मि सागरं R. 1. 2; केनोडुपेन पर लोकनदीं तरिष्ये Mk. 8. 23 --(पः) the moon; Mk. 4. 23. --पतिः, --राज् {1} the moon; जितमुडुपतिना Ratn. 1. 5; रसात्मकस्योडुपतेश्च रश्मयः Ku. 5. 22. {2} Varuṇa, regent of waters. --पथः the sky, the firmament.

k.v: नक्षत्रमृक्षं भं तारा तारकाप्युडु वा स्त्रियाम्. दाक्षायिण्योऽश्विनीत्यादि तारा अश्वयुगश्विनी॥

a: उडुंबरः — 1 N. of a tree; Ficus Glomerata (Mar. औदुंबर). --2 The threshold of a house. --3 A eunuch. --4 A part of a sacrifice. --5 A kind of leprosy with copper spots (--रं also). --6 A kind of worm said to be produced in the blood and to produce leprosy. --रं 1 The fruit of the उदुंबर tree. --2 Copper. --3 A Karṣa, a measure of two tolas. --Comp. --दला, --पर्णी the plant Croton Polyandra.

v: uqucakra

na॰ uqUnAM cakramiva maRqalam । 1 nakzatramaRqale Bacakre tasya saMsTitiSca” si॰ Si॰ uktA uccaSabde tacca darSitam । uqucakrasvarUpAdi sU॰ si॰ uktam yaTA “brahmARqamaDye pariDirvyomakakzABiDI yate । tanmaDye BramaRaM BAnAmaDo'DaH kramaSastaTA । mandAmarejyaBUputrasUryyaSukrendujendavaH । pariBramantyaDo'DasTAH sidDavidyADarA DanAH” । “brahmARqAntaHpariDistattulya mAnaM vfttaM vyomakakzA vakzyamARAkASakakzocyate । tanmaDye brahmARqamaDya AkASe BAnAM nakzatrARAM sarvezAM sarvatastulyorDvAntaritAnAM BramaRaM Bavati । taTA tulyorDvAntareRADoDonakzatreByaH Sanivfhaspa tiBOmArkaSukrabuDacandrAaDastAt pariBramanti । sidDA vidyADArAGanAScADasTAScandrAdaDaHsTitA aDo'DaH krameRAkASe sTitAH । pravahavAyAvavasTAnABAvAScandravanna tezAM pariBramaH” ra॰ nA॰ । tasyotpattiviBAgastatrEva । “punardvAdaSaDAtmAnaM vyaBajadrASisaYjYakam । nakzatrarUpiRaM BUyaH saptaviMSAtmakaM vaSI” sU॰ si॰ । “punarananta ramAtmAna dvAdaSaDA dvAdaSasTAnezu rASisaMjYakaM vyaBajat manaHkalpitaM vfttaM dvAdaSaviBAgaM rASivfttamakarodityarTaH । BUyo dvitIyavAramAtmAnaM nakzatrarUpiRaM saptaviMSAtmakaM vyaBajat । manaHkalpitaM tadeva vfttaM saptaviMSativiBAgaM cAkarodityarTaH । nanu nyUnADikaviBAgAH kaTaM na kftAH? uktasaNKyAyAM niyAmakABAvAdityata Aha vaSIti । icCAvizapaM vaSaM vidyate yasyeti vaSI svatantre cCasya niyogAnarhatvAt । svecCayA tatsaNKyAkA viBAgAH kftA iti BAvaH । saptaviMSativiBAgavyaYjakAni nakzatrARi tArAtmakAni nirmitAnItyarTasidDam” ra॰ nA॰ । tatra rASinakzatranAmAni jyoti॰ ta॰ uktAni yaTA “mezavfzamiTunakarkawasiMhAkanTAtulADaravfScikaBam । DanuraTa makaraH kumBomIna iti ca rASayaH kaTitAH” । “aSvinyA saha BaraRI kfttikApAdaH kIrttitomezaH । vfzaBaH kfttikASezaM rOhiRyardDaYca mfgaSirasaH । mfgaSiraso'rdDaM cArdrA punarvvasostripAdaM miTunam । pAdaH punarvvasorantyaH puzyo'SlezA ca karkawaH kaTitaH । siMho'Ta maGA pUrvaPalgunIpAda uttarAyAH । tacCezaM hastA ca citrArdDaM kanyakAKyaH syAt । tOlini citrArdDaM svAtiviSAKAyASca pAdatrayam । alini viSAKApAdastaTAnurADAnvitA jyezWA । mUlaM pUrvvAzAQA praTamaScApyuttarAMSako DanvI । makarastatpariSezaM SrayaRAcArdDaM kanizWAyAH । kumBo'Ta DanizWArdDaM SataBizApOrvvaBAdrapadatrayam । BAdrapadAyAH SezastaTottarA revatI mInaH” aSvinyAdinakzatrARAM tArAsaMKyAtatsanniveSasvarUpaM ca SrIpatinoktam । “vahnitriftvizuguRendukftAni BUtavARASvinetraSaraBUkuyugAgnirAmAH । rudrAbDirAmaguRavedaSatadviyugmadantA buDErnigaditAH kramaSo BatArAH । turagamuKasadfkzaM yonirUpaM kzurABaM SakawaniBamaTERasyottamANgena tulyam । maRigfhaSaracakrABAni SAlopamaM ca SayanasadfSamanyaccAtra paryyaNkarUpam । hastAkAramajasramOktikasamaM cAnyat pravAlopamaM DizRyaM toraRavat sTitaM baliniBaM syAt kuRqalABaM param । kruDyatkesarivikrameRa sadfSaM SayyAsamAnaM paraM cAnyaddantivilAsavat sTitamataH SfNgAwakavyakti ca । trivikramABaM ca mfdaNgarUpaM vfttaM tato'nyadyamaladvayABam । paryyaNgatulyaM murajAnukAramityevamaSvyAdiBacakrarUpam” । BacakrapariDimAnam si॰ Si॰ uktam “aBrezviBANkagajavuYjarago'kzapakzAH” (2598898850 yojanAni) kakzAM gfRanti gaRakA BagaRasya cemAm” । tasya BUmaDyAtucCritiyojanAni tu tatroktAni yaTA “nAgAkzazaqdvayarasAgnikuvedasaMKyo” (41263658) nakzatramaRqalaBavaH SravaRo niruktaH” । asya ca dvAdaSaDA viBaktasya pravahavAyunA BrAmyamARasya dine zaRAmudayaH rAtrO ca zaRAmiti BedaH । “syAdudgamo nijanijodayaBAnutulye sUryye'staBAskarasamo'stamayaSca BAnAm” si॰ Si॰ ukteH । 2 tArARAM samUhe ca “vapreRa paryyantacaroqucakraH” mAGaH ।

m: उडु—गणाधिप m. ‘the lord of the stars’, the moon
उडु—गणाधिप—र्क्ष n. (˚प-ऋ) N. of the Nakṣatra Mṛgaśiras.

v: uquloman
pu॰ uquriva lomAsya । fziBede । tasyApatyam bAhvA॰ iY । Oqulomi tadapatye puMstrI॰ । bahuzu akAraH । uqulomAH ।
m: उडु—लोमन् m. N. of a man, L.
उडुम्बरा-वती f. N. of a river
See also उदुम्बर and उदुम्बल.
उडुम्बरी (ई), f. Ficus Oppositifolia, Suśr.

s: klI, (uquM vfRAtIti । uqu + vf + ac .) tAmram । iti medinI ॥ (“tAmraM Sulvamuqumbaram” । iti vEdyakaratnamAlA । karzArTe yaTA, -- “uqumbaraSca paryyAyEH karzaeva nigadyate” ॥ iti SArNgaDare pUrvvaKaRqe praTamADyAyaH .) karzaparimARam । iti vEdyakapariBAzA ॥

puM, (uqu + vf + ac .) udumbaravfkzaH । yajYaqumura iti BAzA । tatparyyAyaH । jantuPalaH 2 yajYANgaH 3 hemadugDakaH 4 । ityamaraH ॥ brahmavfkzaH 5 । iti ratnamAlA ॥ hemadugDI 6 yajYaPalaH 7 yajYoqambaraH 8 । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ sadAPalaH 9 kzIravfkzaH 10 SucakzuH 11 SvetavalkalaH 12 । iti jawADaraH ॥ asya guRAH । uqumbaro himo rUkzo guruH pittakaPAsraRut । maDurastuvaro varRyo vraRaSoDanaropaRaH ॥ iti BAvaprakASaH ॥ (“uqumbaraPalaM pakvaM cUrRitaM karzamAtrakam । saMlihenmaDunA sarvvamanupAnaM suKAvaham” ॥ iti vEdyaka rasendrasArasaMgrahe mUtrAGAtADikAre .) anyat udumbaraSabde drazwavyam ॥ dehalI । govarAwera nicera kAWa iti BAzA । paRqam । napuMsakamiti yAvat । kuzWarogaBedaH । iti medinI ॥
v: u(du)qumbara

pu॰ uM SamBuM vfRoti Ka umbaraH utkfzwaH umbaraH prA॰ sa॰ pfzI॰ dasya vA qatvam । (yajYa qumura) 1 yajYANge vfkze 2 tAmre ca, grahAvagrahaRyAm 3 dehalyAm 4 kuzWaBede ca na॰ । “u(du)qumburo yajYaPalo yajYANgo hemadugDakaH । uduqumbarohitorUkzo gurupittakaPAsrajit । maDurastuvarovarRRyovraRaSoDanaropaRaH” iti BA॰ va॰ uktaguRakaH । tasya vikAraH aR । O(du)qumbara tadvikAre pAtrAdO tri॰ । striyAM NIp । “gfhItvOqumbaraM pAtraM jAnuByAM DaraRiM gataH” smftiH । “OqumbarIM spfzwvA gAyeta” SrutiH ।
m: उडुम्बर m. (in Ved. written with द्, in Class. generally with ड्), the tree Ficus Glomerata, AV.; TS.; AitBr.; ŚBr.; MBh.; R.; Suśr. &c.
a species of leprosy with coppery spots, Car.
the threshold of a house, VarBṛS.
a eunuch, L.
a kind of worm supposed to be generated in the blood and to produce leprosy, L.
membrum virile, L.
N. of a people, VarBṛS.
उडुम्बर (अम्), n. a forest of Uḍumbara trees, TāṇḍyaBr.
the fruit of the tree Ficus Glomerata, ŚBr.
copper, VarBṛS.
a karsha (a measure of two tolas), ŚārṅgS.
उडुम्बर—दला or उडुम्बर—पर्णी, f. the plant Croton Polyandrum.

s: strI, (uqumbarasya parRamiva parRaM yasyAH .) dantIvfkzaH । iti SabdacandrikA । (udumbaraparRISabde'syA viSezo jYeyaH ॥)
v: uqumbaraparRI
strI uqrabDarasya parRamiva parRRamasyAH gOrA॰ NIz । dantIvfkze Sabdaca॰ ।

m: उडु—नाथ m. the moon, VarBṛS.

s: puM klI, (uqunojalAt pAti rakzatIti । uqu + pA + ka .) Belakam । BelA mAq ityAdi BAzA । tatparyyAyaH । plavaH 2 koAlaH 3 । ityamaraH ॥ BelakaH 4 uqUpaH 5 taraRaH 6 tAraRaH 7 tArakaH 8 । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ (“titIrzurdustaraM mohAduqupenAsmi sAgaram” ॥ iti raGuvaMSe । 1 । 2 .) candre puM । iti medinI ॥ (“apaSyat vadanaM tasya raSmivantamivoqupam” । iti mahABArate । vanaparbbaRi ॥ carmmAvanadDapAnapAtraM । yaTA, -- “carmmAvanadDamuqupaM plavaH kAzWaM karaRqavat” ॥ iti sajjanaH ॥)
v: uqu(qU)pa

pu॰ uquni jale pAti pA--ka । 1 plave BelAyAm । “uqupaplavasantAroyatra nityaM Bavizyati” BA॰ A॰ 81 a॰ । “vahantovAribahulaM Penoqupapariplutam । BA॰ va॰ 146 । “titorzurdustaraM mAhAdudupenAsmi sAgaram” raGuH । uqurUpajalasantArahetutvAdasya uqupatvam । carmAvanadDayAnapAtre na॰ tacClokavyAKyAne mallinATena “uqupena carmAvanadDayAnapAtreRetyaBiDAya “carmAbanadDamuqupaM plavakAzWaM kasRqavaditi” sajjanoktirudAhftA । pfzo॰ । uqapo'pi plave amarawI॰ । uqUni uqUrpA nakzatrARi pAti pA--ka । 2 candre sa hi tArARAM patiratastadrakzakaH । uqUnAM divA hi sUryyakiraREraBiBavAdaprakASatvena rAtrO ca prakASavattyena niSADISacandrasya tatapatitvam । evam “nakzatrARAmavISatvamoziDInAM taTEva ceti” kA॰ Ka॰ prajApatinA tadaDISatvadAnamuktam” । gotAyAmapi “nakzatrARAmahaM SaSI” ityukteH tanmaDye tasya SrezWatvAdapi tatpatitA “salilamaye SaSini” vfha॰ saM॰ tasya jalamayatvokteH uqumayatvAt jalamayatvAt tasya uqupatitvaM vA boDyam dakzakanyASvinyAditArApatitvAdvA taTAtvam ।
m: उडु—प m. n. a raft or float, MBh.; Ragh. &c.
a kind of drinking vessel covered with leather Comm. on Ragh. i, 2
the moon (the half-moon being formed like a boat), MBh.; Mṛcch. &c.

k.v: उडुपं तु प्लवः कोलः स्रोतोऽम्बुसरणं स्वतः। आतरस्तरपण्यं स्याद्द्रोणी काष्ठाम्बुवाहिनी॥

m: उड्-उप—भृत् m. N. of Śiva, Kāv.

v: uqupaTa
pu॰ uqUnAM panTA' । AkASe । tatra hi uqUnAM pratyahaM pravahavAyunA BramaRAt taTAtvam ।
m: उडु—पथ m. ‘the path of the stars’, the ether, firmament.
उड्-उप—सहा f. pl. the female companions of the moon, BhP.

s: puM, (uqUnAM patiH .) candraH । iti purARajyotize ॥ (“ayAcitopasTitamambu kevalaM rasAtmakasyoqupateSca raSmayaH” । iti kumAre । 5 । 22 । “parimugDatAM vaRigivoqupateH” । iti mAGe .)
v: uqu(qU)pati
pu॰ uqUnAM patiH । 1 candre 2 jaleSe varuRe ca । “parimugDatAM baRigivoqupateH” mAGaH । “rasAtmakasyoqupateSca raSmayaH” kumA॰ ।
m: उडु—पति or उडु—राज्, m. the moon, MBh.; R.; Kum. &c.; the Soma, Suśr.

v: uqurAj
pu॰ uquzu rAjate rAja--kvip । candre । ac, uqUnAM rAjA wac samaH॰ vA । uqurAjo'pyatra “tadoqurAjaH kakuBaH karErmuKaM prAcyAvilimpan” BAga॰ 10, 29 a॰ ।
